audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Wither as a slow Garen must avoid ('Fight inside his W slow', 'his W Wither slow hurts your kiting') and never states that Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows.
audit.why: Garen's Q text: 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him'. Wither is a decaying Move/Attack Speed slow on a 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown. So the correct sequencing is the reverse of the current advice: let Wither land, then Q to cleanse it, and run him down while his only kite is on a 15s timer. The Nasus-side audit reached the same conclusion (its top finding) — this restates it from Garen's side.
audit.corrected: Hold Q until Wither is on you; Decisive Strike purges it and the kite is gone for 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset, or that Fury of the Sands deals percent-health damage.
audit.why: Nasus Q carries autoReset (the wind-up is the tell, not the cast) and his R carries percentHealth — stacking raw armour does not answer it. Flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: Read the Q wind-up as the step-back cue; do not answer his R with armour alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is marked 'Skill 5/10' in both layers, but the packet levelChart has Garen at Level 6 and the why-text already says Garen executes an unfarmed Nasus there.
audit.why: Demacian Justice (120/100/80s) true-damage executes a Nasus who has no dash or escape; the chart row contradicted its own why-text and the packet.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flips to Garen at 7/10, keeping the run of Garen rows through First item and conceding only 2+ items.

audit.why: Garen dominates levels 1-6 and loses the scaled 1v1 once Siphoning Strike is stacked and Fury of the Sands is up; early/mid/late text states this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Wither's 15s rank-1 cooldown is the single punishable window in the matchup, and Q's 8s flat cooldown is what answers it.
audit.corrected: Sequencing added to the all-in and key-interaction lines: eat Wither, Q to purge, commit inside its 15s downtime.
